analysis_y: P.compress -> self.enc(x,ctx,q_encoder) -> compress_prior_2x first argument, before in-place reciprocal scaling
y_hat: compress_prior_2x returned last tensor: sums of centered integer symbols + per-group means, times clamped q_dec; input to actual latent decoder
symbols: process_with_mask returned second tensor, actual centered rounded/clipped/skip-forced y_q; nonoverlapping masks merged; exactly packed for RANS
boundaries: half-integers in y/q_dec - actual conditional mean for active non-saturated entries; force_zero_thres scale boundary separate; no fixed half-integer boundary in raw y
entropy: packed int16 at native entropy_coder.encode_y: signed high8 symbol,low8 actual CDF index; use installed quantized CDF. Tail/escape bypass bits unavailable, so CDF entry bits are partial diagnostic.
prediction: unavailable: feature_extractor produces conditional context, not a defined RGB or analysis-y prediction
